title: Workout library list (get_workouts)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_workouts(start, limit) — the account's workout library, newest first by createdDate (orderBy/orderSeq params are accepted but don't change the order). Consumed by sync_pending_workouts' _find_prior_upload, which looks for a workout an earlier timed-out upload_workout created, matching workoutName and createdDate >= that attempt's start. Each item is the same workout object get_workout_by_id returns, minus workoutSegments.

Verified against: 2026-10-17, a 7-workout library (a deleted workout is absent here and 404s from get_workout_by_id). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true).

createdDate.description: UTC, no offset, e.g. "2026-10-17T15:47:43.0" — verified against a workout uploaded at 15:47:42 container UTC.
